home.heading: Your whole WhatsApp business in one inbox
home.subheading: Shared team inbox, contacts and deals, broadcast campaigns, no-code chatbots and an AI assistant — on the official WhatsApp Cloud API or your own number via QR.

home.featureCrmText: Tags, custom fields, segments and a drag-and-drop sales pipeline.
home.featureCampaignsText: Send personalised broadcasts with templates, scheduling and delivery reports.
home.featureBotsText: Build menus, forms and auto-replies visually — no code needed.
home.featureAiText: Suggested replies, summaries and AI auto-replies trained on your knowledge base.
home.pricingText: Start with a free trial. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel any time.

help.start: Where the flow begins. Set what starts it in Trigger & settings.
help.message: Sends text and/or a file. Variables like '{{first_name}}' are filled in for each contact.
help.menu: Up to 3 options are sent as buttons, up to 10 as a list (Cloud API). QR numbers get a numbered list; customers reply with the number or the option.
help.ask: Asks a question and waits for the answer, which is checked and saved as a variable.
help.condition: Goes down “Yes” or “No” depending on answers or contact data.
help.delay: Pauses the flow, then continues. Customer messages during the wait don't interrupt it.
help.assign: Gives the chat to a teammate. Round-robin picks whoever has the fewest open chats.
help.tags: Adds or removes contact tags, for segments and campaigns.
help.setField: Saves a value to the contact: name, email, consent or a custom field.
help.deal: Creates a deal for this contact in your pipeline.
help.webhook: Sends the conversation's data to your server (signed). Its reply can set variables or answer the customer.
help.ai: Answers the customer with AI, using your knowledge base. If the AI can't help, the flow follows the Handoff path.
help.end: Ends the flow, optionally with a last message and closing the chat.
